title: GH#1004: feat: find email addresses protection cannot hide
body:
## Summary

Resolves #1004.

- Add an explicit Security-panel home-page check and `wp seoprostack email-protection check [<url>]` using the same address/context/source-hint rows.
- Keep HTTP requests bounded to the site's own host and port, with no cookies, redirects, settings changes or ordinary-load requests.
- Document schema, plugin script data and template limitations in README.md and the setting description; update all three changelogs without a version bump.

## Files and reference patterns

Implementation stays in `includes/features/class-seoprostack-email-protection.php`, following the hardening setting-panel hook and added-keys CLI registration patterns. Documentation changes are limited to README.md, changelog.txt and readme.txt.

## Runtime Testing

Risk: high (explicit admin request); testing level: runtime-verified.

Verified head: `5e7e47c8664700774a481c68afd9b08893772fd8`.

- `scripts/lint.sh`: all checks pass, including PHPCS and PHPStan.
- `scripts/preflight-release.sh --offline`: zero errors. Four expected release/listing warnings: two Unreleased headings, WordPress.org slug choice, existing version tag on the release commit. No version bump or publication is intended.
- `scripts/plugin-check.sh`: zero errors in both builds (Plugin Check 2.1.0, WordPress 7.1.4). Existing unrelated warnings remain in unchanged updater, whole-admin theme and database feature files; no finding names the changed feature.
- Disposable WordPress through `scripts/test-site.sh up`: real home-page requests find schema, inline script JSON, JSON attribute, ordinary attribute and template text, but not the protected post-content address. Rank Math 1.0.280 was active with its Local SEO email set; the hint names that exact field.
- Browser verification: Security panel before and after the manual check at desktop 1440px and mobile 390px; expected rows and hint present, protected address absent, zero console errors and no page-level horizontal overflow. Logged out afterwards.
- Repeated CLI/runtime check on minimum WordPress 6.2 / PHP 7.4.33 produces the same rows, with an empty debug log.
- Direct runtime assertions: ordinary panel rendering makes zero HTTP requests; duplicate addresses aggregate all four contexts; entity addresses are detected; protected attributes are ignored; cross-host, cross-port, non-HTTP and credential-bearing URLs are rejected before HTTP.

Docker fixture note: the published loopback port is on the Docker host, so a disposable must-use fixture maps that exact connection back to the web container with `CURLOPT_CONNECT_TO`. The production URL validation and safe HTTP API remain unchanged; no fixture ships.

## Acceptance self-review

| Criterion | Result | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| JSON-LD and script email reported, protected content omitted | Satisfied | Real public-page fetch, CLI and browser rows |
| Rank Math Local SEO hint | Satisfied | Active Rank Math 1.0.280, matching stored email, browser and CLI hint |
| CLI prints the same rows and findings exit 0 | Satisfied | Default and explicit-home CLI invocations |
| No request on ordinary admin loads | Satisfied | Browser initial state plus zero-request runtime assertion |
| All three requested checks have no errors | Satisfied | lint, offline release preflight and Plugin Check pass |

Direct diff/self-review found no material defect. Review bundle SHA-256: `8b5973e2ce0bcd26d1409928be4f3fa66334946e7333ab5ed547cc5caceb1dce` (injection scan clean).

## Decisions

The admin checks the home page; the optional same-site URL is available through CLI. Results are not persisted. Duplicate addresses aggregate their contexts. No unverified Yoast option is named; unmatched sources receive generic guidance.

title: GH#1011: Website Setup board starter tasks (fluentboards_tasks); release 1.3.95
body:
## What

Fluent Boards starter data adds a **Website Setup** board: one task per account and key a site needs, in running order, each with plain steps, links, where its key belongs (never in the task) and when it is done.

1. Setup Hosting (Hostinger, referral link; plan with SSH)
2. Setup Cloudflare (domain DNS and security)
3. Setup aidevops (your AI assistant)
4. Setup SSH Access for aidevops
5. Connect your AI to this Board (Fluent Boards → Settings → MCP for AI Agents; optional)
6. Setup Premium Plugin Updates (GPL Vault): **GitHub builds only** (`starters/github/`, left out of the WordPress.org build at the owner's request)
7. Setup Business Email (Purelymail)
8. Setup Email Sending (Amazon SES + FluentSMTP)
9. Setup File Storage (Cloudflare R2)
10. Setup Google Cloud (budget alert; Search Console)
11. Setup Payment Processing (Stripe, PayPal, Paddle, Polar)

### Code

- New starter item type `fluentboards_tasks` (`includes/class-seoprostack-starters.php`): `board`, `title`, `description` (Markdown), `after`. Matched by title on the board (archived included). Created with `TaskService::createTask()` in the first stage, placed with `Task::moveBetweenTasks()` after `after`, else the previous starter item, else at the top. The stage is renumbered first with `Task::reIndexTasksPositions()`: Fluent Boards stores positions to 2 decimals, and repeated midpoints tied in testing (0.495 → 0.50).
- Remove keeps tasks that were edited, closed, archived, commented on, or that have attachments or subtasks.
- `starters/github/<name>.json` is merged into the starter of the same name; `.distignore-wporg` excludes it, and `scripts/preflight-plugin.sh` parses it.
- Other plugins add tasks to the board through `seoprostack_starters` (SEO Pro Directory will: wpallstars/seoprodirectory#243).
- README: a Website Setup board section with what to click without AI, what an AI runs over SSH, and why to set up SSH first. Release 1.3.95.

## Verification

- Throwaway Docker WordPress with Fluent Boards 2.2.2 (wp.org):
  - Fresh site: 13 items added, in order 1–11; a second add added 0.
  - Edited one task: Remove took back 11 and kept the edited task and its board.
  - PSD-style board (default stages plus legacy cards): generic tasks at the top in order, plus another plugin's tasks after Setup Google Cloud. No position ties.
- `scripts/lint.sh phpstan` OK; PHPCS clean; `php -l`.
- `scripts/preflight-release.sh --ref HEAD`: 0 errors (`wporg: no starters/github`, every `.wporg-links` text replaced).
- `scripts/plugin-check.sh`: no errors in either zip.
- Links checked to load (200) on 2026-10-29.

Resolves #1011

title: GH#1016: Fluent Forms by key: Form by key and Form modal blocks, keyed submissions, policy links; release 1.3.97
body:
Resolves #1016

## What

New feature **Fluent Forms by key** (`SEOProStack_Form_Keys`, Content tab, on by default) and release **1.3.97** (1.3.96 went out from #1014 meanwhile; merged `main` and moved this to 1.3.97).

- `seoprostack/form` (Form by key) and `seoprostack/form-modal` (Form modal) blocks: the form is chosen in the block sidebar from the site's keyed Fluent forms; Form by key previews with ServerSideRender, Form modal shows a summary. Shortcodes `[seoprostack_form]` and `[seoprostack_form_modal]` for places without blocks.
- Keys in Fluent Forms meta `seoprostack_form_key`; `wp seoprostack form-keys list|set|unset`, plus `set --copy-from=<meta-key>` to adopt keys held under an older meta key. Starter data forms accept `key`.
- Form modal: Kadence Blocks Pro's Modal markup in `wp_footer`, its own script/style handles, `enqueue_empty_block_content_assets` kept for the block (WordPress 6.9 dequeues assets of empty-output blocks). Falls back to an in-place panel with the same ID without Kadence Blocks Pro.
- `assets/form-keys.js`: overlay press-from-panel guard, Choices.js list scroll-into-view, visible-only Tab wrap for multi-step forms.
- `assets/form-keys.css`: base look at minimal weight in Kadence's palette and spacing scale (`--global-kb-spacing-*`), beating Kadence Blocks Pro's `.kt-modal-container` and losing to any theme rule naming the classes.
- `seoprostack_form_submitted` action for keyed submissions (CRM hand-offs in other plugins follow keys, not IDs).
- **Policy links in forms open a new tab** (`fluentforms_policy_tabs`, on by default): `seoprostack-new-tab` class, `rel="noopener"`, screen-reader text; `seoprostack_form_policy_paths` filter. Runs at priority 25 and skips links already opening a new tab.
- Code layout (Codacy code-size findings): the feature class keeps settings, hooks, rendering and submissions; `SEOProStack_Form_Key_Store` (lookups and writes), `SEOProStack_Form_Modal`, `SEOProStack_Form_Policy_Links` and `SEOProStack_Form_Keys_CLI` (subcommands `list`, `set`, `unset`) live in `includes/`.

Generalised from a project's must-use plugins so every base-stack site gets it through releases; nothing project-specific is in the plugin.

## Verification

- `scripts/lint.sh php js phpcs phpstan` — all passed; PHPMD (`phpmd.xml.dist`) reports nothing on the five form files.
- `scripts/preflight-release.sh --offline --no-docker` — 0 errors, 1 standing warning (WordPress.org slug note).
- CI: lint, smoke tests (WP 6.2/PHP 7.4, latest/PHP 8.3, multisite), release build + Plugin Check, Codacy, SonarCloud, CodeQL — all passed on the refactor commit.
- Runtime, on a review-copy network with Fluent Forms 6.2.16, FluentCRM 3.2.6 and Kadence Blocks Pro 2.8.20.1 (PR build installed after a tar backup of the previous plugin folder):
  - `form-keys set --copy-from=<older meta key>` set 4 keys; `list` shows them; `set 99 nope` and `set 3 Bad_Key` refuse with their errors.
  - `render('contact-site')`: 9,246 bytes, panel wrapper and the Fluent form; a missing key renders nothing for visitors.
  - Form modal block: nothing in place; `wp_footer` prints the Kadence modal with `aria-labelledby`; Kadence modal script, `seoprostack-form-keys` script and style enqueued.
  - `submitted()` fires `seoprostack_form_submitted('contact-site', …, form 3)` and stays silent for an unkeyed form.
  - Policy links: a privacy link gains `target="_blank" rel="noopener"`, the class and screen-reader text; other links and links already opening a new tab are unchanged.
  - Home, contact and directory pages 200, wp-admin 302; the site's `error_log` gained no lines.
